spec.title: Welcome empty state in sidebar when festinalente not initialized
spec.context: When a user opens the VSCode extension in a project without .festinalente/, the sidebar shows nothing useful. There is no guidance on how to get started. A clear welcome state reduces friction for new users, shows them how to initialize, and makes the extension feel polished rather than broken.

in-scope.item: Welcome state text in Tasks view when .festinalente/ does not exist
Hide non-essential views (Quicks, Config, Directives, Product Docs, Engineering Docs) when not initialized
File watcher on workspace root to detect .festinalente/ directory creation
Dynamic re-initialization of orchestrators when .festinalente/ appears (no reload needed)

out-of-scope.item: Custom webview or rich UI for the welcome state
Running npx festinalente init from within the extension
Welcome state for individual views after initialization (e.g., empty tasks list)

requirements.requirement: When .festinalente/ does not exist, the Tasks view shall display a viewsWelcome message with guidance to run "npx festinalente init"
When .festinalente/ does not exist, all views except Tasks (Quicks, Config, Directives, Product Docs, Engineering Docs) shall be hidden using a "when" clause on festinalente.hasFestinalenteFolder
The extension shall set up a file system watcher on the workspace root to detect creation of the .festinalente/ directory

When the watcher detects .festinalente/ creation, the extension shall dynamically create all orchestrators, register views, commands, and watchers, and update the festinalente.hasFestinalenteFolder context to true
When .festinalente/ exists, the normal kanban view shall be displayed as usual with all views visible
The directory creation watcher shall be disposed after successful initialization to avoid redundant watching

file.reason: Add 'when' clauses to hide non-Task views when not initialized; update viewsWelcome text for Tasks view
Restructure activate() to always set up directory watcher; extract orchestrator setup into a function that can be called on directory creation

pattern.name: setContext for view visibility
pattern.description: Use vscode.commands.executeCommand('setContext', key, value) to control view visibility via when clauses in package.json

pattern.name: viewsWelcome contribution
pattern.description: Declarative welcome content in package.json viewsWelcome array, shown when tree is empty and when clause matches

pattern.name: Factory DI composition root
pattern.description: Thin extension.ts creates orchestrators with deps, registers views and commands. Orchestrator setup can be extracted into a function for re-use.

pattern.name: File system watcher
pattern.description: vscode.workspace.createFileSystemWatcher with RelativePattern for targeted file watching

product.finding: Primary sidebar TreeView showing tasks grouped by status. Auto-refreshes on .festinalente/ changes. This is the view that needs the welcome state.

engineering.finding: 6 domain orchestrators with factory DI. Extension.ts is thin composition root. Extension points doc describes adding new TreeViews.

codebase.finding: Returns early at line 55 when no .festinalente/ found. Sets context but creates no watchers for directory appearance.
Already has a basic viewsWelcome for festinalenteTasks (line 91-96). Only Tasks view has welcome text; other views show empty.
TreeDataProvider that returns StatusGroupItems as root. When no tasks exist, returns empty array which triggers viewsWelcome display.

pitfall.mitigation: Restructure activate() to set up directory watcher before the early return path. Extract orchestrator initialization into a separate function.
Use file watcher + re-init: watch workspace root for .festinalente creation, then dynamically initialize orchestrators without requiring window reload.

pitfall.issue: Welcome text only on Tasks view
pitfall.mitigation: Hide other 5 views via when clause when not initialized; only show Tasks view with welcome message.

constraints.constraint: Must use VSCode native viewsWelcome contribution point, not custom webview
Must use ThemeIcons and ThemeColors only (design directive)
Must follow DAG architecture: orchestrators compose capabilities/computers (coding directive)
Extension.ts must remain a thin composition root

risk.mitigation: Dispose watcher after successful init; use RelativePattern for targeted watching

risks.risk: File watcher on workspace root could have minor performance impact if workspace has many files

risk.mitigation: Extract setup into idempotent function; track initialization state to prevent double-init

risks.risk: Dynamic re-initialization after directory creation needs careful disposal of previous subscriptions if any exist
